summary: Independent E2E validation of the roles/permissions feature using real Supabase JWTs (API + Playwright UI). Core authz WORKS: no token returns 401, the Secretaria gets 403 outside her modules and 403 on delete/export, the admin has full access, roles are combined on the next request without re-login, deactivation cuts off an existing JWT right away, last-admin and self-protection rules hold, temp passwords are shown once, the forced /cambiar-clave screen works, reset password works, and the login rate-limit locks on the 6th try. BUT there are CRITICAL REGRESSIONS: (1) public endpoints used by anonymous visitors are now protected: GET /api/rentals/settings (public pre-reserva page) and GET /api/properties/{id}/share (public share/OG page) both return 401. (2) Every download, preview or link that the browser opens directly (iframe / <a href> / window.open) has no Bearer header, so it gets 401 JSON even for the admin. This covers reservation and contract documents, receipts, liquidación PDFs, photos.zip, people CSV export, comprobantes and document PDFs. The receipts and documents sent to guests by WhatsApp are also broken. Also: delete/export buttons are not hidden for the Secretaria, and clicking them throws an unhandled runtime error.

critical.issue: Now needs auth (alquileres:ver via the /api/rentals prefix). The public page /alquileres/reservar/{slug} (ReservarPropiedad.tsx:31) calls it anonymously to load condicionesGenerales/avisoValidez/whatsappAgencia, gets 401, and guests no longer see the general conditions they must accept. Fix: add ('GET','/api/rentals/settings'): 'PUBLIC' in route_permissions.EXPLICIT_OVERRIDES.

Public OG share page (shared from PublicPropertyDetail.tsx:54 and ShareMenu.tsx to WhatsApp/social crawlers) now returns 401. Every shared property link is broken. Fix: mark it PUBLIC in EXPLICIT_OVERRIDES. Also check the cover/story image URLs used in ShareMenu (coverUrl/storyUrl).

These are opened in an <iframe>/<a target=_blank> (DocPreview.tsx, CobrarSena/CobrarSaldo/Comprobantes) AND sent to guests via WhatsApp links. Browser navigation cannot carry the Bearer header, so the response is 401 {"detail":"Se requiere un token de sesión"}. Verified in the UI: the admin's 'Reserva de alquiler' preview iframe shows that JSON.

The frontend opens these with window.open or an anchor click (LiquidacionesScreen.tsx:182, RentalWorkspace/PropertyWorkspace triggerBrowserDownload, PeopleTableView.tsx:184, DocumentDetail.tsx:266). fetch-interceptor.ts only patches fetch(), so these return 401 for every user, admin included (curl: no-token=401, bearer=200). Fix options: fetch as a blob with the Bearer and then use URL.createObjectURL, OR short-lived signed download tokens (?dl_token=) checked by the backend. For guest-facing docs, use a per-reservation signed public token.

minor.issue: Unauthenticated, so anyone can lock out any account (e.g. the owner's) for 15 minutes by posting their email 5 times. The rate-limit is also only advisory: an attacker can call Supabase signInWithPassword directly and skip it.
mustChangePassword is only enforced in the frontend (RequireAuth). A user with a temporary password can call any API in their role before changing it.
Writes lastLoginAt on every /auth/me call (every page load or session refresh), so 'Último ingreso' is really 'last activity', not last login.
auth.admin.list_users() without pagination returns only the first page (default 50). With more Supabase users, deactivate/reset can't find the user and the ban is silently skipped.
Called globally on every page for non-admin users (Vera bot widget), so the Secretaria gets a 403 on every page load. The widget should be gated by can('vera-bot','ver').

The matrix lets an admin grant 'Usuarios y Roles' (equipo) to a non-admin role, but /api/users and /api/roles are require_admin. The non-admin would see the menu item and land on a screen that fails with 403. Hide 'equipo' from the matrix or map it to the permission.

The role id comes from the name lowercased with spaces replaced by '-' (accents and special characters are kept). Renaming a role does not change its id, so a new role whose name matches an old id gets a 409.

ui_bugs.issue: Delete and export buttons are not gated by can(). The Secretaria sees 'Eliminar' (property, reservation, movimiento, liquidación pago), 'Duplicar a Ventas' and 'Importar de ventas'. Clicking Eliminar on a property calls the DELETE, which correctly gets 403, but the promise rejection is unhandled: a runtime error overlay appears in dev and there is silent failure in prod. No friendly 'no tenés permiso' message. Property was NOT deleted (backend protected).
A user with only 'ver' still sees the 'Nueva propiedad' and 'Importar desde CRM Varela' buttons. There is no action-level UI gating anywhere (can() is only used for the sidebar).

On the next request they get 401, the interceptor signs them out and they land on /login with NO explanation. The requirement was a 'cuenta desactivada' screen. Logging in again shows the generic 'No pudimos ingresar. Revisá el email y la contraseña.' (Supabase reports the user as banned), and the attempt counts toward the rate limit.

The redirect from /veraos/propiedades and /veraos/personas to /veraos/alquileres works, but the restricted screen mounts briefly first and fires /api/properties and /api/people/table, giving 403 console errors. Gate it before rendering the route.

integration_issues.issue: iframe/anchor/window.open URLs pointing at protected /api routes all get 401 (see backend critical items).
GET /api/rentals/settings returns 401, so the condiciones generales are missing (seen in the network log of /alquileres/reservar/test-pago-propietario-c904cd).

issues: Rows with an extra badge ('Clave pendiente'/'Desactivado') wrap the Editar/Resetear/Desactivar actions onto a second line, which is inconsistent with the other rows.
Desactivar has no confirmation dialog (one click deactivates a user).
The sidebar panel does not extend to full height when the page is scrolled (it ends partway down, see the screenshot). Probably pre-existing.

action_items: CRITICAL: mark GET /api/rentals/settings and GET /api/properties/{property_id}/share as PUBLIC in route_permissions.EXPLICIT_OVERRIDES (also review the cover/story image endpoints used by ShareMenu).

CRITICAL: fix every browser-navigated backend URL (iframe src, <a href>, window.open, triggerBrowserDownload) — recibo-sena, saldos recibo, documento/reserva, documento/contrato, comprobante(s), liquidacion pdf (both), photos.zip (rentals + properties), people/export, documents/{id}/pdf. Fetch with Bearer and turn the response into a blob URL, or add short-lived signed download tokens. Guest-facing docs shared by WhatsApp need a public signed-token URL.
HIGH: gate delete/export/create buttons in the UI with can(module, action) and catch 403s with a friendly 'No tenés permiso' message instead of an unhandled rejection.
MEDIUM: show a 'cuenta desactivada' screen when the 401 detail is 'No tenés acceso activo a VERA OS' (and on a Supabase 'banned' login error) instead of a silent sign-out to /login.
MEDIUM: protect /api/auth/login-failed from abuse (rate-limit by IP, or only count failures confirmed server-side). Consider enforcing mustChangePassword in the backend.
LOW: gate the Vera bot widget fetch (/api/brain/conversations) by can('vera-bot','ver'); remove 'equipo' from the role matrix or honor it; paginate list_users; add a confirm dialog for Desactivar.
critical_code_review_comments: fetch-interceptor only covers window.fetch. Any URL the browser loads by navigation (iframe/a/window.open/img) never carries the Bearer header, which is the root cause of the document/download regressions.

route_permissions prefix default '/api/rentals' -> alquileres caught the public helper /api/rentals/settings, and '/api/properties' caught the public /share page. The fail-closed mapping is good, but the public endpoints were not inventoried from the frontend's public pages (app/public/*).
apply_authorization takes only next(iter(methods)) for multi-method routes. None exist today, but a future @api_route(methods=[GET,POST]) would get the wrong action.
routes_users.list_users is called once per row: build_profile does one roles query per user (N+1). Fine for a small team.
Rate limit is advisory only: login goes straight from the browser to Supabase, so this is UX friction, not real brute-force protection (Supabase's own rate limits still apply).

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (all requested role/user flows pass; download/preview, public settings, and button gating fail)

rca of the issue: Downloads/previews: the auth design switched from open API to Bearer-in-header, but only fetch() was patched. Browser navigations (iframe/anchor/window.open) can't add headers, so all file/PDF/ZIP endpoints now 401. Repro: log in as admin > Alquileres > Reservas > Finalizadas > click the 'Reserva' doc button; the iframe shows {"detail":"Se requiere un token de sesión"}. Public regressions: route_permissions defaults by prefix, and /api/rentals/settings and /api/properties/{id}/share were not listed as PUBLIC overrides. Repro: curl https://real-estate-os-10.preview.emergentagent.com/api/rentals/settings gives 401.
